name: GitHub
selection_rule: Read code/docs, resolve canonical owner, check archive state and license scope; stars are discovery signals only.

name: Habr
selection_rule: Original author, technical mechanism and dated evidence; distinguish company blogs, translation and repost.

name: OpenNet
selection_rule: Follow news references to original release/code/paper; a headline is not sufficient.

name: Yandex SmartCaptcha docs
selection_rule: Use documented protocol boundaries only as evidence for a concrete RE case; standalone integration guides are excluded.

name: Kanxue
selection_rule: Exact public thread plus original author/traces required; never substitute a forum home page for a read article.
inspection_note: Read sections of exact public threads 292935 and 292866; neither has been accepted. This supersedes the earlier access failure.

name: CSDN
selection_rule: Require original author/work, date provenance and primary references; reject scraped/repackaged SEO summaries.

name: Cnblogs
selection_rule: Prefer original implementation/experiments; trace reposts to the first publisher.

name: iT 邦幫忙
selection_rule: Select specific technical posts with primary references; popularity alone is insufficient.

name: Qiita CAPTCHA topic
selection_rule: Read the complete article and repository/version; do not accept tag pages as articles.

name: Zenn CAPTCHA topic
selection_rule: Prefer reproducible technical posts and authored books; preserve Japanese title and translation notes.

name: LY Corporation engineering
selection_rule: Select relevant first-party engineering work, distinguishing translation from independent corroboration.

name: LINE Engineering
selection_rule: Require an actual article, mechanism and evidence; treat related corporate publications as one publisher group.

name: Kakao Tech
selection_rule: Read article/slides/transcript; a video landing page alone remains a lead.

name: Viblo
selection_rule: Prioritize original Vietnamese experiments with exact version and source references.
inspection_note: Reverse-engineering tag directory read; no original anti-bot article established.

name: SSTIC
selection_rule: Read selected paper/slides with named authors; require direct topic relevance.

name: CCC media archive
selection_rule: Inspect slides/transcript and timestamps; distinguish archival talks from current claims.

name: Developpez
selection_rule: Require primary code/research behind the article; retry only through allowed public access.

name: Heise developer
selection_rule: Trace original technical work; do not count reporting and the cited original as independent results.

name: Information Security Stack Exchange
selection_rule: Question context, answer evidence and present-day applicability must all be read; votes alone are insufficient.

name: arXiv
selection_rule: Read relevant methods and limitations, pin paper version, follow code/data; label preprint status accurately.

name: Hugging Face datasets
selection_rule: Read dataset card, version, provenance and per-asset license; downloads/likes are not quality proof.

name: W3C
selection_rule: Use exact protocol semantics to resolve a concrete RE observation; general surveys do not become catalogue entries.

name: MDN
selection_rule: Match feature/version; translations share one evidence origin.

name: Cloudflare technical material
selection_rule: Use original mechanisms/docs, not marketing outcomes; all translations are one publisher.

name: hCaptcha docs
selection_rule: Use documented protocol boundaries only as evidence for a concrete RE case; standalone integration guides are excluded.

name: PortSwigger Research
selection_rule: Only browser/protocol/instrumentation work directly relevant to scope; exclude unrelated vulnerability news.

name: Check Point Research
selection_rule: Select original JavaScript/VM analysis with sample provenance; exclude generic product pages.

name: nullpt.rs
selection_rule: Inspect exact current article, code and sample provenance; blocked or old material is not retained.
observation: Original Nike-VM parts 1 and 2 returned server errors; no article content inferred. This observation does not establish that the site is permanently unavailable.

name: GitLab
selection_rule: Resolve original project and public source; a mirror is not an independent resource.

name: Codeberg
selection_rule: Same repository gates as GitHub; avoid platform bias.

name: Gitee
selection_rule: Establish upstream identity and license; distinguish original projects from mirrors.

name: USENIX
selection_rule: Read full browser measurement/security paper and artifact; preserve experimental conditions.

name: NDSS
selection_rule: Read full relevant paper, version and artifact; no venue-wide endorsement.
